related.title: Mantevo 代理程式：stencil 與穩定步長
related.titleEn: Mantevo proxy applications: stencils and stable steps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付DFT契約、脈衝/單頻測試與計畫成本表；24/48及還原3一致，報告含DFT符號、長度、stride與縮放；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver DFT contracts, impulse/tone tests and planning costs. Verify 24/48 and recovered 3 with sign, length, stride and scaling documented. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫5點網格與固定端點，區分內點更新與邊界強制；新舊陣列分開；.4/.6可重算，接受前者且以明示穩定理由拒絕後者。
related.differenceEn: Draw five grid points/fixed endpoints, separating interior updates from boundary enforcement and old/new buffers. Reproduce 0.4/0.6, accept the former and reject the latter using the stated bound.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 未正規化的正反DFT合成得到N×x；還原時需明確除N，而非假設函式庫自動除；合成N8，原始單元素x=3；改N16，同樣只觀察對應元素的正反合成；名義式 8*3 = 24 unnormalized reconstructed value；變更式 16*3 = 48 unnormalized reconstructed value。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
u新_i=u_i+r(u左−2u_i+u右)，r=κΔt/Δx²；一維等距顯式擴散的常見穩定限制r≤1/2；合成κ1、Δx.1，Δt.004對.006；先只計r，不外推多維；名義式 1*.004/.1**2 = 0.4 dimensionless r；變更式 1*.006/.1**2 = 0.6 dimensionless r。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Unnormalized forward/inverse DFTs compose to N×x; recovery explicitly divides by N. Synthetic N 8, original element x 3; compare N 16 at the same forward-inverse element. Nominal 8*3 = 24 unnormalized reconstructed value; changed 16*3 = 48 unnormalized reconstructed value. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

u_new=u_i+r(u_left−2 u_i+u_right), r=kappaDt/Dx²; the one-dimensional uniform explicit diffusion bound is r≤1/2. Synthetic kappa 1, Dx = 0.1, Dt = 0.004 versus 0.006; compute r only without multidimensional extrapolation. Nominal 1*.004/.1**2 = 0.4 dimensionless r; changed 1*.006/.1**2 = 0.6 dimensionless r. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: AMReX：局部細化與有效格點預算
related.titleEn: AMReX: local refinement and active-cell budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付DFT契約、脈衝/單頻測試與計畫成本表；24/48及還原3一致，報告含DFT符號、長度、stride與縮放；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver DFT contracts, impulse/tone tests and planning costs. Verify 24/48 and recovered 3 with sign, length, stride and scaling documented. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫十個粗區塊其中一個細化為八子格，分開標有效、覆蓋及ghost類型；1700/2400正確，常數場體積總量守恆，儲存與有效量分欄。
related.differenceEn: Draw ten coarse regions with one replaced by eight children. Label active, covered, and ghost categories separately. Verify 1700 and 2400 with constant-field conservation. Report storage separately from active cells.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 未正規化的正反DFT合成得到N×x；還原時需明確除N，而非假設函式庫自動除；合成N8，原始單元素x=3；改N16，同樣只觀察對應元素的正反合成；名義式 8*3 = 24 unnormalized reconstructed value；變更式 16*3 = 48 unnormalized reconstructed value。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。

三維粗格N中比例f以每軸r倍細化，有效格數N(1−f)+Nfr³；覆蓋粗格不重複當有效；合成N=1000、f=.1、r2；改f=.2，無ghost cells；名義式 1000*(1-.1)+1000*.1*2**3 = 1700 active cells；變更式 1000*(1-.2)+1000*.2*2**3 = 2400 active cells。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Unnormalized forward/inverse DFTs compose to N×x; recovery explicitly divides by N. Synthetic N 8, original element x 3; compare N 16 at the same forward-inverse element. Nominal 8*3 = 24 unnormalized reconstructed value; changed 16*3 = 48 unnormalized reconstructed value. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

For refined fraction f and per-axis ratio r, active 3 D cells equal N(1−f) + N f r³. Covered coarse cells are excluded from active counts. Synthetic N = 1000, f = 0.1, r = 2; compare f = 0.2, excluding ghost cells. Nominal 1000*(1-.1)+1000*.1*2**3 = 1700 active cells; changed 1000*(1-.2)+1000*.2*2**3 = 2400 active cells. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
